// Stock changes: posting movements to the append-only ledger and updating lots (FEFO).
var __TURBOPACK__imported__module__$5b$project$5d2f$lib$2f$db$2e$js__$5b$app$2d$rsc$5d$__$28$ecmascript$29$__ = __turbopack_context__.i("[project]/lib/db.js [app-rsc] (ecmascript)");
var __TURBOPACK__imported__module__$5b$project$5d2f$lib$2f$replenishment$2e$js__$5b$app$2d$rsc$5d$__$28$ecmascript$29$__ = __turbopack_context__.i("[project]/lib/replenishment.js [app-rsc] (ecmascript)");
;
;
const IN_TYPES = [
    'RECEIPT',
    'RETURN'
];
const OUT_TYPES = [
    'ISSUE',
    'ADJUSTMENT'
];
const MOVEMENT_TYPES = [
    ...IN_TYPES,
    ...OUT_TYPES,
    'TRANSFER'
];
// Take quantity out of a warehouse, First-Expiry-First-Out: oldest expiry lots are used first
async function takeFefo(tx, medicineId, warehouse, qty) {
    const lots = await tx.query(`SELECT lot_no, qty, to_char(expiry_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS expiry FROM lots
     WHERE medicine_id = $1 AND warehouse = $2 AND qty > 0 ORDER BY expiry_date, lot_no FOR UPDATE`, [
        medicineId,
        warehouse
    ]);
    const available = lots.reduce((s, l)=>s + l.qty, 0);
    if (available < qty) throw new Error(`Only ${available} unit(s) available in ${warehouse}`);
    const used = [];
    let left = qty;
    for (const lot of lots){
        if (left <= 0) break;
        const take = Math.min(lot.qty, left);
        await tx.query('UPDATE lots SET qty = qty - $1 WHERE lot_no = $2', [
            take,
            lot.lot_no
        ]);
        used.push({
            lot_no: lot.lot_no,
            qty: take,
            expiry: lot.expiry
        });
        left -= take;
    }
    return used;
}
// Add quantity to a lot (create it if new)
async function putIntoLot(tx, medicineId, warehouse, lotNo, expiry, qty) {
    const existing = (await tx.query('SELECT medicine_id, warehouse FROM lots WHERE lot_no = $1', [
        lotNo
    ]))[0];
    if (existing && (existing.medicine_id !== medicineId || existing.warehouse !== warehouse)) {
        throw new Error(`Lot ${lotNo} belongs to another medicine or warehouse`);
    }
    if (existing) {
        await tx.query('UPDATE lots SET qty = qty + $1 WHERE lot_no = $2', [
            qty,
            lotNo
        ]);
    } else {
        if (!expiry) throw new Error('A new lot needs an expiry date');
        await tx.query('INSERT INTO lots (lot_no, medicine_id, warehouse, qty, expiry_date) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)', [
            lotNo,
            medicineId,
            warehouse,
            qty,
            expiry
        ]);
    }
}
// After stock changed: recompute ROP/status, raise an alert and a purchase-order draft if needed
async function afterStockChange(tx, medicineId, actor) {
    await tx.query(__TURBOPACK__imported__module__$5b$project$5d2f$lib$2f$replenishment$2e$js__$5b$app$2d$rsc$5d$__$28$ecmascript$29$__["RECOMPUTE_SQL"], [
        medicineId
    ]);
    const r = (await tx.query(`SELECT r.status, r.on_hand, r.rop, r.coverage_days, r.suggested_order, m.unit_cost
     FROM replenishment r JOIN medicines m ON m.id = r.medicine_id WHERE r.medicine_id = $1`, [
        medicineId
    ]))[0];
    if ([
        'stockout',
        'below_rop',
        'at_risk'
    ].includes(r.status)) {
        const open = await tx.query(`SELECT 1 FROM alerts WHERE medicine_id = $1 AND type = $2 AND status <> 'resolved'`, [
            medicineId,
            r.status
        ]);
        if (!open.length) {
            await tx.query(`INSERT INTO alerts (medicine_id, type, severity, message) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`, [
                medicineId,
                r.status,
                r.status === 'at_risk' ? 'medium' : 'high',
                `After a movement by ${actor}: on hand ${r.on_hand}, ROP ${r.rop}, coverage ${r.coverage_days ?? 0} d`
            ]);
        }
        const po = await tx.query(`SELECT 1 FROM purchase_orders WHERE medicine_id = $1 AND status = 'awaiting_pharmacist'`, [
            medicineId
        ]);
        if (!po.length && r.suggested_order > 0) {
            await tx.query(`INSERT INTO purchase_orders (medicine_id, qty, est_cost, reason) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`, [
                medicineId,
                r.suggested_order,
                (r.suggested_order * Number(r.unit_cost)).toFixed(2),
                `Status ${r.status} after movement: on hand ${r.on_hand}, ROP ${r.rop}`
            ]);
        }
    }
    return r;
}
async function postMovement({ code, type, warehouse, toWarehouse, qty, lotNo, expiry, note, actor }) {
    return (0, __TURBOPACK__imported__module__$5b$project$5d2f$lib$2f$db$2e$js__$5b$app$2d$rsc$5d$__$28$ecmascript$29$__["transaction"])(async (tx)=>{
        const med = (await tx.query('SELECT id, unit FROM medicines WHERE code = $1', [
            code
        ]))[0];
        if (!med) throw new Error(`Unknown medicine code ${code}`);
        const insert = (wh, lot, t, q)=>tx.query('INSERT INTO movements (medicine_id, warehouse, lot_no, type, qty, actor, note) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)', [
                med.id,
                wh,
                lot,
                t,
                q,
                actor,
                note || null
            ]);
        let detail;
        if (IN_TYPES.includes(type)) {
            const lot = lotNo || `L${String(med.id).padStart(5, '0')}-${warehouse.slice(3)}-${Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()}`;
            await putIntoLot(tx, med.id, warehouse, lot, expiry, qty);
            await insert(warehouse, lot, type, qty);
            detail = `${type} +${qty} ${med.unit} into lot ${lot} (${warehouse})`;
        } else if (OUT_TYPES.includes(type)) {
            if (type === 'ADJUSTMENT' && !note) throw new Error('An adjustment (write-off) needs a reason in the note');
            const used = await takeFefo(tx, med.id, warehouse, qty);
            for (const u of used)await insert(warehouse, u.lot_no, type, -u.qty);
            detail = `${type} −${qty} ${med.unit} from ${warehouse} using FEFO lots ${used.map((u)=>`${u.lot_no}×${u.qty}`).join(', ')}`;
        } else if (type === 'TRANSFER') {
            if (!toWarehouse || toWarehouse === warehouse) throw new Error('Choose a different destination warehouse');
            const used = await takeFefo(tx, med.id, warehouse, qty);
            for (const u of used){
                const destLot = `${u.lot_no}-T${toWarehouse.slice(3)}`;
                await insert(warehouse, u.lot_no, 'TRANSFER_OUT', -u.qty);
                await putIntoLot(tx, med.id, toWarehouse, destLot, u.expiry, u.qty);
                await insert(toWarehouse, destLot, 'TRANSFER_IN', u.qty);
            }
            detail = `TRANSFER ${qty} ${med.unit} ${warehouse} → ${toWarehouse}`;
        } else {
            throw new Error('Unknown movement type');
        }
        const r = await afterStockChange(tx, med.id, actor);
        await tx.query('INSERT INTO audit_log (actor, action, entity, details) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)', [
            actor,
            'post_movement',
            code,
            `${detail}. New status: ${r.status}, on hand ${r.on_hand}`
        ]);
        return {
            detail,
            status: r.status,
            onHand: r.on_hand
        };
    });
}
